correctness.rationale: Every CF3 face either lies in one full factor simplex or meets exactly two factors in independent sets. The core is the homotopy colimit of a cofibrant incidence diagram; all inclusions to the pairwise joins nullhomotope. A connected incidence graph has first Betti C(r−1,2), producing (r−2) suspensions per singleton node. Attaching full simplices by nullhomotopic cofibrations adds one more suspension per factor. The cycle specialization uses Kozlov’s exact recurrence. Ten complete finite GF(2) checks agree, but the proof is topological and integral.

originality.rationale: The primary 2026 source defines CF3 and gives a disjoint-union join identity and shellability results, not the proposed graph-join homotopy splitting. The earlier cycle recurrence only evaluates the independence-complex factors. A prior matched-multipartite subfamily is properly covered, but does not imply the universal result. Targeted semantic searches and the actual inspected primary sections revealed no equivalent or dominating formula. An unlocated differently phrased theorem remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: A structurally equivalent graph-of-spaces application might appear under another name and was not identified by the targeted searches.
Only selected relevant sections of the primary full texts were materially read; uninspected appendices or other literature might contain a stronger result.
The previously established matching-factor special case is subsumed; novelty is strictly the arbitrary triangle-free factor theorem and cycle families.
